-- Check how location relates to equipment
SELECT loceqref FROM location LIMIT 5;

-- Check equipment codes
SELECT equipmentcode FROM equipment LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    e.equipmentcode,
    ce.heaterstatus,
    t.insulationstatus,
    l.emergencylightstatus,
    ws.structuralloadpercent,
    ws.snowloadkgm2,
    ws.windspeedms,
    -- Compute SSF
    ((100.0 - ws.structuralloadpercent) / 100.0) * 
        CASE 
            WHEN ws.snowloadkgm2 > 100 OR ws.windspeedms > 20 THEN 0.5
            WHEN ws.snowloadkgm2 > 50 OR ws.windspeedms > 10 THEN 0.8
            ELSE 1.0
        END AS ssf
FROM equipment e
JOIN cabinenvironment ce ON ce.cabineqref = e.equipmentcode
JOIN thermalsolarwindandgrid t ON t.thermaleqref = e.equipmentcode
JOIN lightingandsafety l ON l.lighteqref = e.equipmentcode
JOIN location loc ON loc.loceqref = e.equipmentcode
JOIN weatherandstructure ws ON ws.weatherlocref = loc.locationregistry
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    e.equipmentcode AS equipment,
    ce.heaterstatus,
    t.insulationstatus,
    l.emergencylightstatus,
    ROUND(CAST(
        ((100.0 - ws.structuralloadpercent) / 100.0) * 
            CASE 
                WHEN ws.snowloadkgm2 > 100 OR ws.windspeedms > 20 THEN 0.5
                WHEN ws.snowloadkgm2 > 50 OR ws.windspeedms > 10 THEN 0.8
                ELSE 1.0
            END
    AS numeric), 4) AS structure_margin,
    CASE 
        WHEN ((100.0 - ws.structuralloadpercent) / 100.0) * 
                CASE 
                    WHEN ws.snowloadkgm2 > 100 OR ws.windspeedms > 20 THEN 0.5
                    WHEN ws.snowloadkgm2 > 50 OR ws.windspeedms > 10 THEN 0.8
                    ELSE 1.0
                END > 0.7
        AND ce.heaterstatus != 'Off'
        AND t.insulationstatus != 'Poor'
        AND l.emergencylightstatus IN ('On', 'Testing')
        THEN 'Extreme Weather Ready'
        ELSE 'Not Ready'
    END AS readiness_label
FROM equipment e
JOIN cabinenvironment ce ON ce.cabineqref = e.equipmentcode
JOIN thermalsolarwindandgrid t ON t.thermaleqref = e.equipmentcode
JOIN lightingandsafety l ON l.lighteqref = e.equipmentcode
JOIN location loc ON loc.loceqref = e.equipmentcode
JOIN weatherandstructure ws ON ws.weatherlocref = loc.locationregistry
WHERE 
    ((100.0 - ws.structuralloadpercent) / 100.0) * 
        CASE 
            WHEN ws.snowloadkgm2 > 100 OR ws.windspeedms > 20 THEN 0.5
            WHEN ws.snowloadkgm2 > 50 OR ws.windspeedms > 10 THEN 0.8
            ELSE 1.0
        END > 0.7
    AND ce.heaterstatus != 'Off'
    AND t.insulationstatus != 'Poor'
    AND l.emergencylightstatus IN ('On', 'Testing');
